name: Bishoujo Shashinkan - Bangai Hen - Outside Story
original_name: 美少女写真館 番外編 アウトサイドストーリー
source:
This is a story of everyday life in female-dominant police department. Yuko conducts investigations, arrests and enjoys her work as police officer.

[From [url=http://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/05/vn-of-year-1990.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
本作描写一座女性占主导地位的警察局里的日常生活。优子调查案件、逮捕犯人，并尽情享受警察这份工作。

[引自[url=http://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/05/vn-of-year-1990.html]vndbreview[/url]]
